subject: general
question: What is the name of the initiative launched by SEBI and IEPFA to assist investors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Niveshak Shivir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SEBI and IEPFA__ have launched the __'Niveshak Shivir'__ initiative to assist investors in reclaiming unclaimed dividends and shares.**
 
• The initiative aims to enhance financial literacy and reduce investor dependence on intermediaries.
 
• Dedicated helpdesks will be set up to provide direct assistance from company representatives and Registrars & Transfer Agents (RTAs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Niveshak Shivir'__ program is a joint initiative by __SEBI and IEPFA__ to help investors recover unclaimed dividends and shares.
 
• The initiative aims to raise financial literacy among investors and provide direct support through helpdesks.
 
• The program also seeks to reduce the reliance of investors on intermediaries by providing clear and direct assistance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• SEBI__

 __
 
• SEBI, or the Securities and Exchange Board of India, is the regulatory authority for securities and commodities markets in India.
 
 
 
• IEPFA__
 
 
• The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) is responsible for promoting investor education and protecting investor interests.
